title: Wanano language
description: Tucanoan language spoken in Brazil and Colombia
extract: Guanano is a Tucanoan language spoken in the northwest part of Amazonas in Brazil and in Vaupés in Colombia. It is spoken by the Wanano. The Wanano and the closely related Pira-tapuya do not intermarry, but their languages are 75% lexically similar.
